youtube.title: Why Socrates' wife dumped a bucket of water on him 🪣 #shorts
youtube.caption:
Socrates spent all day asking strangers "what is justice?" for free... while his wife Xanthippe handled the rent. 🏛️🪣

Greek philosophy, but it's a group chat.

Whose side are you on? 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on the ancient story (Diogenes Laertius): after scolding Socrates, Xanthippe soaked him with water and he said "didn't I say Xanthippe's thunder would end in rain?"

#socrates #philosophy #greekphilosophy #historymemes #history #ancientgreece #shorts
